note: Working search query patterns discovered by the scout. WebFetch to ATS/board domains now generally works, but many company career sites are JS-rendered SPAs whose static HTML/markdown extract has no per-job detail (Ashby's jobs.ashbyhq.com HTML pages return only 'Jobs' header with no content -- ALWAYS use the api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<board> JSON endpoint instead; Google careers, Meta careers (metacareers.com), and myworkdayjobs.com job-detail pages are JS-rendered and returned empty content this run too -- treat Workday postings as unverifiable via WebFetch for now). Prefer each ATS's public JSON API over the HTML page when possible (see below). Re-check egress/rendering access each run in case it changes.

working_fetch_patterns.greenhouse: Use https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<board_token>/jobs/<job_id> (plain JSON, no auth) instead of the HTML job page when the HTML page renders a full board index instead of the single job. This run the API 404'd for censys (job id from search snippet was stale/wrong), and direct job-boards.greenhouse.io HTML pages for clickhouse and openly 404'd, while transcendinc's job id resolved to a completely different job ('Staff Technical Account Manager II') -- all four search-snippet ids were stale/reused and dropped without adding.
working_fetch_patterns.lever: Direct job HTML at jobs.lever.co/<co>/<uuid> confirmed 403 again this run for moonpay and copia. The public API https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/<co>?mode=json works for confirming a company's CURRENT posting list, but the WebFetch summarizer sometimes truncates/samples a large postings list rather than returning all entries -- for copia and moonpay the API response summarized only a handful of postings and did not surface the specific SRE/Platform/Infra roles search snippets pointed to, so those went unverified and were dropped (not necessarily fake, just unconfirmed this run).
working_fetch_patterns.ashby: https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<board_name> (case-sensitive board name) returns full JSON job list including title/location/isRemote/publishedAt -- this is the ONLY reliable way to verify Ashby postings; the jobs.ashbyhq.com HTML page is pure JS and WebFetch sees just 'Jobs' with zero content. Confirmed working this run for boards: avantos, merciv, elliptic, Clera, berlitz, ivo-inc, makai-labs, regard. IMPORTANT: cross-check the specific job UUID from a WebSearch snippet against the API's CURRENT listing -- Regard's 'Senior DevOps Engineer' UUID from a fresh search snippet was NOT present in the live API listing this run (API shows zero DevOps/SRE/Infra/Platform roles currently) and was dropped as stale. Elliptic, Clera, berlitz, and ivo-inc all currently have zero matching-title roles or only non-US-remote roles (Elliptic: Lead DevOps in London only; Berlitz: Senior Platform & DevOps in Germany Remote only; Clera and ivo-inc: no DevOps/SRE/Infra/Platform titles at all) -- dropped as non-matching, not stale.
working_fetch_patterns.myworkdayjobs: Individual job-detail pages under *.myworkdayjobs.com (tried salesforce.wd12 and ssctech.wd1 this run, with and without /en-US/ prefix) returned completely empty content via WebFetch -- same JS-rendering problem as Google/Meta careers. Treat any Workday job-detail candidate as unverifiable via current WebFetch access; don't add/notify without another verification path.
working_fetch_patterns.bloomberg: bloomberg.avature.net/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> is directly WebFetch-reachable and gives title/location/live-status reliably (no posted date shown on the page). Not re-checked this run (no new candidate ids surfaced).
working_fetch_patterns.twosigma: careers.twosigma.com/careers/JobDetail/<slug>/<id> reachable, but job IDs from search snippets can be stale/404 -- not re-checked this run beyond a general careers search that surfaced only already-known-pattern Software Engineer roles (id 12453, 7452, 13992, 389), none matching target titles closely enough to verify.
working_fetch_patterns.builtinnyc: www.builtinnyc.com/job/<slug>/<id> reachable and reliably shows a 'this job was removed at <timestamp>' notice for dead postings. This run 5 of 6 fresh SRE/Infra candidates were dead-on-fetch (Trade Desk, CoreWeave, MongoDB Dev Infra, Coinbase, Medal) despite appearing in a fresh search -- only worth trusting after a direct fetch confirms it's still live. Atlassian/Loom job id 287713 (very old-looking low id) 404'd outright.
working_fetch_patterns.wellfound: Individual job URLs (wellfound.com/jobs/<id>-<slug>) are directly WebFetch-reachable and give full detail when live. This run the HackerRank 'Senior DevOps Engineer' candidate (id 3700734) was HTTP 410 Gone -- dropped.
working_fetch_patterns.google_careers: www.google.com/about/careers/applications/jobs/results/<id> is JS-rendered -- WebFetch only sees nav/header, no job content. Not re-searched this run.
working_fetch_patterns.metacareers: www.metacareers.com/jobs/<id>/ is also JS-rendered -- WebFetch only sees 'Meta Careers' header, no job content. Not re-searched this run.
